column15: bit 0 = Global fault; bit 1 = AutoSpan fault; bit 2 = Temperature fault; bit 3 = 4-20 mA fault; bit 4 = Input voltage fault; bit 5 = Memory fault; bit 6 = Processor fault; bit 7 = Clearing fault; bit 8 = Stability fault; bit 9 = Range fault; bit 10 = Sensor fault; bit 11 = Zero fault; bit 12 = Sensor fault 2; bit 14 = In calibration; bit 15 = Communication error

column7: Read gives status; write starts an action.
column15: 0 = Read: idle; 1 = Read: zero calibration started / Write: set zero; 2 = Read: span calibration started / Write: set span; 3 = Read: span set; 4 = Read: span calibration unsuccessful; 8 = Write: signal simulation mode; 9 = Write: set FP bridge voltage; 10 = Write: set TP heater power; 11 = Write: set IR gain

column7: Units, a space, then gas name, null-terminated; first character in the low byte of each register.
